name: scryToActions
signature: export function scryToActions(effect: Extract<ExtendedEffect, { do: 'scry' }>, ctx: AbilityContext, env: PrimitiveEnv): PrimitiveResult
rules: CR 701.18a look at the top N, put any number on the bottom, rest on top in any order
contract: Scrying with an empty library emits nothing and defers nothing: there is nothing to look at and no decision to make.
Scry 1 with exactly one card in the library is STILL a decision - top or bottom - so it defers. A primitive that treated a one-card look as forced would be silently choosing for the player.
The deferred line names the player and the number, verbatim enough that the log shows what was skipped.
It emits no MOVE_ZONE speculatively: reordering the top of a library the player has not chosen is a hidden, unreplayable state change.
count of zero or less emits nothing and defers nothing.

evidence.claim: scry is a player decision delegated to the player object

assertions.expect: zero actions, one deferred naming scry 2
still deferred - top or bottom is a real choice

assertions.given: scry over a library shorter than the count
assertions.expect: the deferred line names the number of cards actually looked at
